english.title: Make / use false document to avoid payment / fail to pay charge made under charging scheme
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) made or used a false document, namely **(..SPECIFY DOCUMENT..), with intent to avoid payment of, or being identified as having failed to pay, charges imposed by a charging scheme under Part III of the Transport Act 2000 or charging scheme penalty charges
english.legislation: Contrary to section 173(6) and (8) of the Transport Act 2000.
english.pointstoprove:
date and location
made OR used a false document
with intent to avoid payment of OR
being identified as having failed to pay a charge imposed by a charging scheme under Part III of the Transport Act 2000

investigatoraction.description: Guilty Plea by letter procedure may be offered for this offence
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.standardstatementoffacts: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) the defendant made or used a false document , namely **(..SPECIFY DOCUMENT..), with intent to avoid payment of, or being identified as having failed to pay, charges imposed by a charging scheme under Part III of the Transport Act 2000 or charging scheme penalty charges.

other.penalty:
Summary: maximum 6 months imprisonment and / or a fine not exceeding level five on the standard scale.

Time limit for prosecutions:
6 months
